evidence.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable potential in Verilog code generation, yet existing datasets contain con siderable noise and redundancy.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: For quality, a multi-granularity pipeline first verifies functional correctness through testbench simulation and then filters misaligned samples via Instruction-Following Difficulty (IFD) scoring.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on three LLMs and three benchmarks show that VeriSelector outperforms full-dataset training and state-of-the-art baselines us ing only 20%-25% of the data, achieving Performance Retention Rates above 118% and reducing training time by over 80%.
